MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   B. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

3. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
